= demo: the fixture library
:toc: left
:toclevels: 2
:idprefix:
:sectanchors:

demo is the smallest library the superproject builds, which the tests of its
build place in `libs/demo` of a scratch superproject, a path with a space in
it.

[#quick-start]
== Quick start

A program asks for the answer:

[source]
----
include::{examples}/hello.cpp[lines=7..-1]
----

It prints:

[listing]
----
include::{examples}/hello.expected[]
----

A program that throws and catches prints what it caught, where exceptions are
on:

[listing]
----
include::{examples}/catches.expected[]
----

[#holds]
== What it holds

demo has {n-examples} examples: {n-examples-native} built natively,
{n-examples-wasip2} for wasip2 and {n-examples-wasip3} for wasip3. It has
{n-tests} tests, {n-boost-test-suites} of them a Boost.Test suite:
{n-tests-native} run natively, {n-tests-wasip2} on wasip2 and {n-tests-wasip3}
on wasip3. Each of its {n-headers} headers compiles alone.
